headline: PHP2Shell hits Check Point gateways in destructive attacks; N-central zero-day exploited after PoC; SCKit ScreenConnect MSP attacks

bullets.text: New: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-123039) is being exploited in destructive attacks on Check Point gateways, per SecurityWeek. No fixed release is on the board.

N-central (PoC, 6 outlets): the new N-able zero-day was exploited hours after a PoC was published, and attackers infected 21 servers, 19 of them on Hotfix 2, so patched servers are not safe. No CVE or fix is on the board.
MSPs (8 outlets): worm-like SCKit malware spreads through ScreenConnect support sessions, nearly 50 organizations report breaches, and ConnectWise has disabled third-party extensions.

Still active: hackers compromised 4,800 GitHub accounts to steal cloud credentials (5 outlets), and Apify is rotating API tokens after a breach. The FBI details North Korea's $400M fake Zoom scheme; the US seized $1.2B in crypto stolen from Binance.

Apache httpd patched a critical HTTP/2 RCE, CVE-2026-119618 (4 outlets). Critical Xen Orchestra flaws are exploited. SignDrop Windows zero-day abuses CLFS for SYSTEM; no fix on the board. Also: Fireworks AI/Notion (6 outlets), Turla (6), Maersk (5).

KEV due today (11-13): Barracuda CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560. Due 11-24: Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320, Outlook CVE-2026-124194, Chromium CVE-2026-125350. SITCON 3; the last 7 days run 1.09x the 90-day average.

actions: Check Point: restrict gateway management interfaces to trusted networks, back up configs, and watch vendor advisories for a CVE-2026-123039 fix.
N-central: treat servers as exposed even on Hotfix 2; take consoles off the internet and hunt for new admin accounts, unexpected agent commands and implants.
ScreenConnect: inventory instances and extensions, confirm third-party extensions are disabled, and hunt for SCKit spreading from support sessions.
GitHub: review org members' recent sign-ins, PATs and Actions secrets; rotate cloud credentials in repos or workflows, and Apify tokens if you use it.
Patch every Apache httpd instance for CVE-2026-119618; where you cannot, consider disabling HTTP/2 until patched.
Patch Barracuda ESG today (KEV deadline 11-13) and restrict Xen Orchestra to trusted networks.
